record.body:
## Interfaces

The Textual UI, the tmux plugin, dashboard-status and their tests are removed. Survivors moved by git mv to dashboard/backend/ (model, journal, gates, landing, approval, backlog, dismiss) and dashboard/backend/server/ (app, service, __main__). dashboard/bin/web starts backend/server/__main__.py and the server serves dashboard/web/ui/dist. orchestra status [DIR] [--count] (orchestra/status_cli.py) loads the snapshot, merges landings, and prints per-effort counts or the needs-you total. The README Testing section and the suite.py fallback name three pytest commands and no tmux pass.

## Assumptions

orchestra may import dashboard lazily inside the status command. The merge-branch landing items count in orchestra status because the design says merged needs-you.

## Invariants

The web server starts and serves the snapshot after every task. Moves changed only imports and path constants. No Python file imports textual or rich. No test writes to a real .canon store.

## Conflicts

none
